title: The difficulty of refusing care
lines: It is harder to refuse a system when it can heal the people you love.
Concordia Series imagines linked futures shaped by an intelligence that is effective, reasonable, and often compassionate.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Retain gentle care and a person’s hesitation; avoid a sinister overseer or rescue climax.
voiceDirections: Speak with tender tension; give gentle emphasis to heal the people you love. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.
Speak with warm uncertainty; give gentle emphasis to often compassionate. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.

title: A world made helpful
